shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rounded-top slab/stele-like field
framing lines/border running along the curved upper edge
rectilinear grid or hatched patterning as filler
justification: Both are shallow relief panels with an arched top framed by border lines, and both use rectilinear hatched/grid patterning somewhere in the field, but that is a generic formal correspondence rather than a shared motif. A is a figural scene with standing human figures, a seated/kneeling figure, offerings and sign-like elements, while B shows only an abstract architectural or netted/gridded rectangular structure with chevron-banded borders and no figures at all.
